class.name: GIFAnimation
class.brief_description: Decoded or authored animated GIF resource.
class.description: Holds GIF canvas size, Netscape loop count, source patches, and optional baked full-canvas frames. Use [method bake_frames] to compose disposal methods. Convert to [SpriteFrames] with [method to_sprite_frames] for [AnimatedSprite2D].

method.name: add_source_frame
method.description: Appends a source frame. Delay is in hundredths of a second.

method.name: bake_frames
method.description: Composes source patches onto the canvas using each frame's disposal method.

method.name: from_sprite_frames
method.description: Builds a GIF animation from a [SpriteFrames] animation.

method.name: get_active_texture
method.description: Returns the texture used for the given frame in the current display mode.

method.name: get_baked_image
method.description: Returns a composed full-canvas image, if baking has run.

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of source frames.

method.name: get_frame_delay
method.description: Returns the frame delay in hundredths of a second. Missing or zero delays use 10.

method.name: get_frame_delay_sec
method.description: Returns the frame delay in seconds, at least 0.01.

method.name: get_frame_disposal
method.description: Returns the GIF disposal method for the frame.

method.name: get_frame_has_transparency
method.description: Returns whether the frame uses a transparent color index.

method.name: get_frame_position
method.description: Returns the source patch origin on the canvas.

method.name: get_frame_transparent_color
method.description: Returns the transparent palette index, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_source_image
method.description: Returns the undecoded source patch for the frame.

method.name: load_from_path
method.description: Decodes a GIF from a file.

method.name: save_to_buffer
method.description: Encodes this animation as GIF bytes.

method.name: save_to_path
method.description: Encodes this animation to a [code].gif[/code] file.

method.name: to_sprite_frames
method.description: Bakes frames into a [SpriteFrames] animation. Disposal metadata is not preserved.

method.name: wrap_frame
method.description: Wraps a frame index into the valid range.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], baked frames are VRAM-compressed when possible.
Whether baked frames are stored in the [code].res[/code] or rebuilt on load.
Whether playback uses source patches or composed frames.

signal.name: frames_changed
signal.description: Emitted after frames are loaded or appended.

constants.constant: Store baked images in the resource.
Clear the frame rectangle to transparent.
Restore the canvas from before this frame.
